record.question: Choose the incorrect statement about Refund of Earnest Money.
options: Earnest money shall be refunded on receipt of performance guarantee.
Earnest money of all bidders except the lowest bidder should be refunded immediately after expiry of bid validity period.
Entry of demand draft/ banker's cheque received as earnest money with the tenders is kept in the Register of Valuables.
Earnest money deposit of bidders unsuccessful during technical bid evaluation etc. should be returned within 30 days of declaration of result of technical bid evaluation.
record.explanation: Non-lowest bidders' earnest money is not refunded only after bid validity expiry.
